prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore and an Undo button in the message shown after deleting an episode, in both languages. All 23 backend tests pass (8 of them new), the frontend type-check is clean, and the changed files show only lint problems that were already there. A restored episode comes back with its cuts at the number it had when deleted, and the episodes from there on move down one. If the project now has fewer episodes than that, it goes at the end. Anyone outside the workspace, or asking after the project was deleted, gets a 404 with NOT_FOUND_EPISODE. Restoring an episode that isn't deleted returns it unchanged, so pressing Undo twice is harmless. Changes beyond the request: the shared toast component gained an optional action button so Undo could live in it, and the delete messages are now in both languages instead of hard-coded English. A side effect: because a delete keeps the episode's cuts, restore brings back the cuts it had at that moment.

+"""
+Episode numbering: a project's live (not deleted) episodes are always numbered
+1, 2, 3, ... with no gaps or repeats.
+
+Every write that adds, copies or removes an episode goes through `place()`,
+which locks the project row (on Postgres) so concurrent writes are serialized,
+and renumbers the project's episodes in one go.
+"""
+from typing import List, Optional
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.models import Episode, Project
+
+
+def lock_project(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> Optional[Project]:
+    """Lock the project row for the rest of the transaction (no-op on SQLite)."""
+    return session.exec(
+        select(Project).where(Project.id == project_id).with_for_update()
+    ).first()
+
+
+def live_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> List[Episode]:
+    """The project's live episodes in display order (stable tie-break for legacy data)."""
+    return list(session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)  # noqa: E711
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id)
+    ).all())
+
+
+def place(
+    session: Session,
+    project_id: UUID,
+    episode: Optional[Episode] = None,
+    position: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> None:
+    """
+    Renumber the project's live episodes 1..n. If `episode` is given (a new,
+    not yet numbered episode), it is inserted at 1-based `position` (clamped;
+    appended when None) and the episodes from there on move down one place.
+    Call before committing; the caller should hold `lock_project`.
+    """
+    ordered = [
+        ep for ep in live_episodes(session, project_id)
+        if episode is None or ep.id != episode.id
+    ]
+    if episode is not None:
+        if position is None:
+            position = len(ordered) + 1
+        index = min(max(position, 1), len(ordered) + 1) - 1
+        ordered.insert(index, episode)
+    for number, ep in enumerate(ordered, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != number:
+            ep.episode_order = number
+            session.add(ep)

+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _project(client, h, titles):
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    ids = []
+    for i, title in enumerate(titles, start=1):
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h,
+                        json={"title": title, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": i, "story_summary": f"{title} summary"})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+        ids.append(r.json()["id"])
+    return pid, ids
+
+
+def _add_cuts(episode_id, scripts):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import StoryCut
+
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        for order, script in enumerate(scripts, start=1):
+            s.add(StoryCut(episode_id=UUID(episode_id), cut_order=order, script=script,
+                           selected_layout="single", aspect_ratio="1:1",
+                           image_path=f"cuts/{order}.png", dialogues=[{"speaker": "A", "text": script}]))
+        s.commit()
+
+
+def _listed(client, h, pid):
+    return [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={pid}", headers=h).json()]
+
+
+def _restore(client, h, episode_id):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/restore", headers=h)
+
+
+def test_restore_puts_episode_back_at_its_place_with_its_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, (a, b, c) = _project(client, h, ["A", "B", "C"])
+    _add_cuts(b, ["one", "two", "three"])
+
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{b}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("C", 2)]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{b}", headers=h).status_code == 404
+
+    r = _restore(client, h, b)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    restored = r.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == b
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "B summary"
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3)]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{b}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+    cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={b}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(c["cut_order"], c["script"], c["dialogues"]) for c in cuts] == [
+        (1, "one", [{"speaker": "A", "text": "one"}]),
+        (2, "two", [{"speaker": "A", "text": "two"}]),
+        (3, "three", [{"speaker": "A", "text": "three"}]),
+    ]
+    assert all(c["image_path"] for c in cuts)
+
+
+def test_restore_first_and_last_episode(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, (a, b, c) = _project(client, h, ["A", "B", "C"])
+
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}", headers=h)
+    assert _restore(client, h, a).json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3)]
+
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{c}", headers=h)
+    assert _restore(client, h, c).json()["episode_order"] == 3
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restore_after_other_changes_keeps_numbering_without_gaps(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, (a, b, c, d) = _project(client, h, ["A", "B", "C", "D"])
+
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{c}", headers=h)  # C was 3
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}", headers=h)  # now B=1, D=2
+    assert _restore(client, h, c).json()["episode_order"] == 3  # past the end: appended
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("B", 1), ("D", 2), ("C", 3)]
+    assert _restore(client, h, a).json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("D", 3), ("C", 4)]
+
+
+def test_restoring_a_live_episode_changes_nothing(client):
+    h = signup(client)

+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2)]
+
+
+def test_restore_twice_is_harmless(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, (a, b, c) = _project(client, h, ["A", "B", "C"])
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{b}", headers=h)
+    assert _restore(client, h, b).status_code == 200
+    assert _restore(client, h, b).status_code == 200
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3)]
+
+
+def test_non_member_cannot_restore(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    pid, (a, b) = _project(client, owner, ["A", "B"])
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}", headers=owner)
+    stranger = signup(client, email="stranger@example.com")
+
+    for episode_id in (a, b):  # deleted and live: both look missing
+        r = _restore(client, stranger, episode_id)
+        assert r.status_code == 404
+        assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+    assert _listed(client, owner, pid) == [("B", 1)]
+
+
+def test_unknown_episode_and_deleted_project_give_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, (a,) = _project(client, h, ["A"])
+    r = _restore(client, h, "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}", headers=h)
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    r = _restore(client, h, a)
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+
+def test_restore_requires_auth(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, (a,) = _project(client, h, ["A"])
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}", headers=h)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}/restore").status_code == 401
